final: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS rc, AVG(rental_rate)/AVG(rental_duration) AS dp FROM film GROUP BY rating), m AS (SELECT AVG(dp) AS mdp FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.rc) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(r.dp) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(r.dp - m.mdp) AS avg_excess FROM r, m WHERE r.dp > m.mdp
